title: Заставить и разрешить без to
description: Заставить и разрешить без to: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Использовать make someone do в активной конструкции
notes: Let + человек + инфинитив без to: They let us leave.
В активной модели make someone do также нет to: The rule made us wait. Пассивная модель имеет другие особенности и здесь не проверяется.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The organiser let us ___ the room early.
exercises.explanation: После let us нужна начальная форма без to.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: return / to return.

public_payload.sentence: The missing form made me ___ to the office.

exercises.editorial_answer: The missing form made me return to the office.
exercises.explanation: В активном make me return предлог to не ставится.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Нам разрешили воспользоваться боковым входом.»
exercises.editorial_answer: They let us use the side entrance.
exercises.explanation: Let us use — активная модель разрешения без to.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The coach made us to repeat the exercise.

accepted: The coach made us repeat the exercise.

exercises.reference_answer: The coach made us repeat the exercise.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The coach made us to repeat the exercise.
exercises.editorial_answer: The coach made us repeat the exercise.
exercises.explanation: В активной конструкции make someone do убирается to.

exercises.prompt: Почему волонтёры могли войти в восемь?

public_payload.passage: The venue normally opened at nine, but the organiser let the volunteers enter at eight to prepare. A missing delivery made them change the layout of the room. They used smaller tables near the wall and left a wider path through the middle. The change was inconvenient, but it did not prevent the event from starting on time.

options.label: The delivery driver forced every door open.
The organiser gave them permission to prepare early.
The public opening time had always been eight.

exercises.editorial_answer: The organiser gave them permission to prepare early.
exercises.explanation: Let выражает специальное разрешение, отличное от обычного открытия в девять.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: let — разрешать; make — заставлять в этой конструкции; permission — разрешение; requirement — требование
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: let — разрешать; make — заставлять в этой конструкции; permission — разрешение; requirement — требование.

public_payload.passage: The venue normally opened at nine, but the organiser let the volunteers enter at eight to prepare. A missing delivery made them change the layout of the room. They used smaller tables near the wall and left a wider path through the middle. The change was inconvenient, but it did not prevent the event from starting on time.

options.label: A decision to cancel the event.
A rule requiring a late start.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Can we begin before the public arrives?

options.label: The manager has let us starting early.
The manager has let us start early.
The manager has let us to start early.

exercises.editorial_answer: The manager has let us start early.
exercises.explanation: Let us start использует инфинитив без to.

public_payload.sentence: To allow an action is to ___ it.

exercises.explanation: Permit означает разрешать, в отличие от prohibit.
